card.fact_statement: The SPD and CDU/CSU parliamentary groups reached a coalition agreement on 9 April.
card.source_span: On 9 April, both SPD and the CDU/CSU parliamentary groups had reached a coalition agreement to form a new cabinet under Friedrich Merz’s chancellorship.

target_qa_variants.question: An welchem Datum einigten sich die Fraktionen von SPD und CDU/CSU auf einen Koalitionsvertrag zur Bildung des Kabinetts Merz?
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 9 April, both SPD and the CDU/CSU parliamentary groups had reached a coalition agreement to form a new cabinet under Friedrich Merz’s chancellorship.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'reach a coalition agreement' to 'einigten sich ... auf einen Koalitionsvertrag'. Adapted date format to standard German.

backtranslation_en.question: On what date did the parliamentary groups of the SPD and CDU/CSU agree on a coalition agreement to form the Merz cabinet?
